metadata.title: SlotMate — Smart Appointment Scheduling
metadata.description: Mobile-first Progressive Web App for organizing time slots and appointments effortlessly.

hero.title: Organize every time slot with clarity.
hero.subtitle: SlotMate is built mobile-first, with native multi-language support and Progressive Web App installability. Supabase integration will begin in Milestone 2.

slots.title: Daily Schedule (Local Preview)
slots.subtitle: Select a time slot to simulate a local booking without a database.

pwa.title: PWA Foundation
pwa.subtitle: SlotMate includes a web app manifest, dedicated icons, and Service Worker registration.
pwa.installedNotice: SlotMate is already installed or running in standalone mode.
pwa.iosHint: On iPhone/iPad: tap Share in Safari and choose "Add to Home Screen".
pwa.browserHint: On desktop or Android you can install the app from the browser menu when served over HTTPS.

roadmap.title: Milestone 1 Plan
roadmap.subtitle: What is already in place and what comes next.

items.title: Next.js App Router + TypeScript
items.description: Modern structure with strict type validation.

items.title: Italian default + EN, AR, ES
items.description: Typed translation dictionaries and automatic RTL for Arabic.

items.title: Mobile-First UI + PWA
items.description: Manifest, PNG icons, Service Worker, and touch navigation.

items.title: Supabase Integration (Milestone 2)
items.description: Authentication, real slot persistence, and notifications.

footer.note: SlotMate · Milestone 1 · Ready for the next development phase.

login.metaDescription: Sign in to your SlotMate account with persistent session support.
login.title: Welcome back to SlotMate
login.subtitle: Enter your credentials to access your persisted session.
login.loggedOutNotice: You have been signed out safely.
login.confirmedNotice: Email verified successfully. You are now signed in.

register.metaDescription: Create your SlotMate account and set up your workspace.
register.title: Create your SlotMate account
register.subtitle: Sign up in seconds to initialize your profile and workspace.
register.businessNameHint: If provided, your initial business workspace is created automatically.
register.passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters to keep your account secure.
register.confirmEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to your email address. Open it to complete sign-in.
register.confirmEmailHint: Check your spam or promotions folder if you don't see it within a minute.
